node.title: Re^5: Convert string to hash
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
More than that, I seem to recall that this either already is deprecated and scheduled to be removed

I see you've found the reference, but since I've collected a few more links I'll post my reply anyway ;-)

The "autoderef" feature was [doc://perl5140delta#Array-and-hash-container-functions-accept-references|introduced in v5.14], warnings about the experimental status were [doc://perl5200delta#New-Warnings|added in v5.20], and the feature was [doc://perl5240delta#The-autoderef-feature-has-been-removed|removed in v5.24]. Also in v5.24, [doc://perlref#Postfix-Dereference-Syntax] was taken out of experimental status; I believe the idea was it would serve as a replacement for autoderef (pop $arrayref becomes pop $arrayref->@*). See also [doc://perlexperiment].
